patterns.note: Asymmetrical two-column layouts are frequently used, often with text on one side and a dynamic cluster of images on the other.
A vibrant, saturated yellow is used as a dominant brand color for hero backgrounds and key call-to-action sections, providing high contrast against dark text and white content areas.

The hero section features a layered parallax effect where the large 'Bumble' text remains relatively fixed or scrolls slower, while the overlapping images within and around it move upwards at a faster rate, revealing more of the yellow background.
Feature sections are presented as distinct, rounded-corner cards with a small icon, title, description, and call-to-action, often arranged side-by-side.
Large, bold, and condensed headings are used for primary messaging, often integrated visually with image elements, contrasting with smaller, highly legible body text.

technique_notes: The hero section creates a dynamic brand statement by positioning large, bold text as a background layer, with multiple overlapping and slightly rotated images animated to scroll at a different speed, creating a parallax depth effect.
Content sections frequently pair a block of text with a collage of multiple, slightly tilted and overlapping images, giving a lively, scrapbook-like feel.
Key call-to-action sections are highlighted with a full-width, vibrant yellow background, featuring a QR code and device mockups to encourage app downloads.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, bold, and condensed headings (~4-5x body) create strong visual impact, complemented by clear, medium-weight body text.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners are consistently applied to buttons, image containers, and content cards, creating a soft and approachable feel.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy spacing, with generous padding around sections and elements, particularly in the hero, contributing to a clean and modern aesthetic.

standout: The most distinctive aspect is the highly dynamic and interactive hero section, where the brand name is visually integrated with a layered parallax of overlapping images. This creates an immediate sense of playfulness and modernity, making the brand feel vibrant and engaging from the first glance.
